issue: Favorites view is incorrectly filtered by the Documents module filter
actual: Favorited 'API Versioning Strategy' (API module) and 'Database Schema Design' (Data Layer module); count updated immediately to 2, favorite markers survived sort/filter in Documents, and favorites persisted after reload (count still 2) - all correct. However, when the Documents module filter was set to 'API' and then the Favorites tab was opened, only 'API Versioning Strategy' was shown; 'Database Schema Design' was missing from the Favorites list even though favorites.count still showed 2. Resetting the Documents filter to 'All' made both favorites reappear in the Favorites view, confirming Favorites list rendering is filtered by the module selected in Documents instead of showing every favorited document regardless of that filter.
